hero.title: Qualify and select your open source software with
hero.description: QSOS is a free and open methodology to describe, evaluate and compare open source software in order to make decisions transparent, auditable, documented and reproducible.

method.title: Four steps, one repeatable process
method.description: Each step produces reusable artefacts, so evaluations can be shared, challenged and updated over time instead of being rebuilt from scratch.

define.title: Define
define.description: Frame the reference data: software families, evaluation grids and the criteria that matter for your context.

evaluate.title: Evaluate
evaluate.description: Score each candidate against maturity and functional criteria on a simple, auditable 0–1–2 scale.

qualify.title: Qualify
qualify.description: Weight the criteria according to your own requirements, constraints and risk appetite.

select.title: Select
select.description: Compare weighted results side by side and document a decision anyone can reproduce.

activity.title: Activity
activity.description: Activity inside and around the project

value.badge: What you get out of it
value.title: Why QSOS makes a difference

defensibility.title: Defensibility
defensibility.description: Scored artefacts that survive audit. Justify your choices with evidence-backed evaluations.

reusability.title: Reusability
reusability.description: CC-BY-SA 4.0 evaluations travel between teams. Share knowledge instead of duplicating work.

auditability.title: Auditability
auditability.description: Transparent and reproducible process. Every score is traceable and verifiable.

flossDepth.title: FLOSS depth
flossDepth.description: Maturity axes generic tools ignore. Evaluate what really matters for open source sustainability.

mutualization.title: Mutualization
mutualization.description: Share the workload across projects. Build on community evaluations and contribute back.

contextWeighted.title: Context-weighted
contextWeighted.description: Same software, different contexts, different scores. Adapt evaluations to your constraints and priorities.

why.title: A method that evaluates open source must itself be open.
why.description: OSS governance cannot be credibly outsourced to proprietary analysts. The community that produces open source should also own the tools that assess it, distributed under a free licence to guarantee reuse, objectivity and peer-reviewed improvement.

legacy.title: Legacy
legacy.description: Scattered tools, XML grids, fragmented usage.

eclipse.title: Eclipse
eclipse.description: Anchored in the Eclipse Foundation for governance.

qsos-agent.title: QSOS Agent
qsos-agent.description: GenAI & MCP augmentation for assisted evaluation.

cta.title: Join and contribute to Eclipse-QSOS.
cta.description: Help build the open standard for qualifying open source software.

footer.description: QSOS — Qualification and Selection of Open Source Software.
